dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast, sharp-edged white transverse bands are visible across the distal portions of the folded flight feathers against a black background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a bright red, fleshy caruncle at the anterior of the head; rectrices and lower primaries exhibit bold, high-contrast black and white transverse barring.
